Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>

CommitDate: Tue Jan 21 20:57:29 2025 +1300

    Bug 1942554 - When closing a view, keep the database open if it's large. r=mkmelin
    As well as not closing large databases when they're idle, let's not close then when the user switches folder.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D234932

diff --git a/mail/modules/DBViewWrapper.sys.mjs b/mail/modules/DBViewWrapper.sys.mjs
index cf2c69d5d25..36b0e7cf468 100644
--- a/mail/modules/DBViewWrapper.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/modules/DBViewWrapper.sys.mjs
@@ -688,7 +688,12 @@ DBViewWrapper.prototype = {
    *  is a getter that will always try and load the message database!
    */
   _releaseFolderDatabase(aFolder) {
-    if (!aFolder.isSpecialFolder(Ci.nsMsgFolderFlags.Inbox, false)) {
+    if (
+      !aFolder.isSpecialFolder(Ci.nsMsgFolderFlags.Inbox, false) &&
+      aFolder.databaseOpen &&
+      aFolder.msgDatabase.databaseSize <
+        Services.prefs.getIntPref("mail.db.keep_open_size")
+    ) {
       aFolder.msgDatabase = null;
     }
   },
